description: Alice 1:1 prep (2026-10-16) marked the Houston travel block 'STATUS: RESOLVED' and said 'The travel closed out cleanly', including the Westchase hotel checkout/early-departure-fee issue. David states the hotel was never resolved. Teams shows Alice's last word on it was Oct 14 20:01 asking for an update ('I can call them again') with no resolution message after.
correction: The hotel checkout/early-departure fee is UNRESOLVED. Status must not be marked resolved without a message or artifact showing resolution.
root_cause: Inferred closure from the absence of further traffic rather than from evidence of resolution.
